note: gitBaseCommit is the Phase 3.1 commit this build was branched from; the build itself corresponds to the Phase 3.2 commit that adds this manifest file to the repository - see 'git log' for its exact hash.

whisperModel.requirement: optional - required only for live speech transcription; manual transcript entry is fully supported without one
whisperModel.licensingStatus: not applicable - CIP never bundles, downloads, or redistributes a model; the operator supplies and is responsible for their own model file's license

notBuildableInThisEnvironment.appimage: appimagetool/linuxdeploy not installed and this environment has no egress to auto-download them
notBuildableInThisEnvironment.msi/nsis (Windows): cannot cross-build a Windows installer from this Linux container
notBuildableInThisEnvironment.dmg/app (macOS): cannot cross-build a macOS installer from this Linux container

knownLimitations: Real microphone audio capture: NOT AVAILABLE in every environment this project has been built in so far (no /dev/snd)
Real Whisper transcription of real speech: NOT AVAILABLE (needs both a real model and real microphone audio)
Physical monitor/projector output: NOT AVAILABLE (no physical display in any build environment used so far; only Xvfb virtual-display software validation exists)
Acoustic (audio-fingerprint) music recognition: no real recognition backend implemented (text/lyric-based music matching is fully functional)
CSP is null in tauri.conf.json (deferred; zero fs/shell/http/dialog plugin surface limits practical exposure - see docs/phase-3-2-hardware-pilot.md Security section)
Multi-hour (2-4 real wall-clock hours) stability: NOT VERIFIED in this environment - only a compressed simulated-load equivalent was run
requiredHardwareForFullOperation: a microphone (optional - manual transcript entry is a full substitute)
a real local Whisper model file (optional)
a second display or projector (optional - single-display/manual-preview pilot is fully supported)
offlineStatus: fully offline for every core capability (Bible search/detection/presentation, all six intelligence domains, the unified workspace, presentation display); one non-functional diagnostic TCP reachability probe exists and affects only a status indicator
pilotStatus: PILOT READY - CONDITIONAL (software); CHURCH HARDWARE PILOT = HOLD pending real microphone/Whisper/projector verification on target hardware - see docs/phase-3-2-hardware-pilot.md
